run_greeter_server: run the gRPC Greeter server that responds to SayHello requests with a greeting message
test_SayHello: test the Greeter SayHello method by sending a HelloRequest and asserting the response message
create_greeter_servicer: create a Greeter servicer class that extends GreeterServicer and implements the SayHello RPC method
review_listening_server: review the _listening_server context manager that starts a gRPC server on a random port
refactor_Greeter_SayHello: refactor the Greeter SayHello method to calculate and return request duration in the response
